items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Can you tell us any more about the Salistan style? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Always did.

ctx.x: I just couldn't bring that man to mind. Yeah, he was great. Strong voice and power. Hey, he could sing any kind of numbers, you know. Don't care what time is it. Yeah.
Can you tell us any more about the Salistan style? I mean, did he always play sort of a sweet style with the old band? Always did.
